title: SharePoint one-time passcode sign-in for external users is being retired
summary: SharePoint Online and OneDrive are retiring their own one-time passcode (OTP) sign-in for external users and moving to Microsoft Entra B2B guest accounts. The retirement started in commercial tenants in mid-October 2026 and is expected to be complete by the end of November 2026. External people without a matching guest account can then see 'access denied' on links shared with them earlier.
why: Partners and customers may suddenly lose access to files you shared with them, and the support calls land with your team rather than theirs.
todo: Run sharing reports on key sites to find external people who rely on OTP links.
Create guest accounts for them in advance, or reshare one item to create the account.
Check that external collaboration settings allow the right people to invite guests.
effective_note: Rolling out from mid-October; expected complete by end of November 2026
